programmes.programName: Doctoral Programme in Industrial Engineering and Management
programmes.evidence: Official FEUP 2026/27 course page titles this Doctoral Degree in Engineering and Industrial Management and describes it as the Doctoral Programme in Industrial Engineering and Management, with 6 semesters, 180 ECTS and independent innovative research. This is one course; the two English word orders are not two awards.
limitations: The FEUP English page uses two English word orders in its title and body. Programme label here follows the body, which explicitly says Industrial Engineering and Management; official Portuguese title is Engenharia e Gestão Industrial.
The formal degree is labelled Doctoral Degree on this official page; no literal PhD credential is inferred.
DEGI department association is plausible but not explicitly stated as formal host on this programme page, so department and unitIds are withheld.
